Workflow automation Chain prompts together for repeatable content workflows.

Bottom line

Copy.ai's free plan is the real story here — it's one of the few in this category you can use meaningfully without paying. The tradeoff is fewer advanced controls than Jasper, so power users doing high-volume brand content will likely outgrow it, but as a starting point it's hard to beat.

Frequently asked questions

Is Copy.ai actually free?

Yes, there's a genuinely usable free plan, not just a trial.

What do you get on the free plan?

A limited but real monthly word allowance across most core writing tools.

Is Copy.ai good for teams?

It supports team seats on paid plans, though Jasper has deeper brand-voice controls for larger teams.

Does Copy.ai have an API?

A limited API is available; check current plan details for quota.

How does Copy.ai compare to Jasper?

Copy.ai is friendlier for beginners and has a free plan; Jasper has stronger brand-voice and team features at a higher price.

When was Copy.ai last tested by Luvent?

We last tested it on 2026-07-01.
